description: This file defines the IFieldCodecProvider interface, which provides methods to access codecs for different field types within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: IFieldCodecProvider
classes.description: Interface providing access to field codecs for serialization.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified generic type TField.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec for the specified generic type TField, returning null if not found.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified Type object.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec for the specified Type object, returning null if not found.
